sql: select * from "masjids" where "masjids"."user_id" = ? and "masjids"."user_id" is not null and "masjids"."deleted_at" is null limit 1

select * from "masjid_user" where "masjid_user"."user_id" = ? and "masjid_user"."user_id" is not null and exists (select * from "masjids" where "masjid_user"."masjid_id" = "masjids"."id" and "masjids"."deleted_at" is null) order by "masjid_id" asc
select * from "groups" where "groups"."id" = ? and "groups"."deleted_at" is null and "groups"."masjid_id" = ? limit 1
select exists(select * from "group_staff" where "group_id" = ? and "user_id" = ? and "group_staff"."masjid_id" = ?) as "exists"
select * from "groups" where "groups"."id" = ? and "groups"."deleted_at" is null and "groups"."masjid_id" = ? limit 1
select * from "masjids" where "masjids"."id" = ? and "masjids"."deleted_at" is null limit 1
select * from "school_years" where "masjid_id" = ? and "school_years"."masjid_id" = ? order by "first_day" asc
select * from "school_closures" where "school_closures"."school_year_id" in (1) and "school_closures"."masjid_id" = ? order by "closed_on" asc

select * from "group_memberships" where "group_memberships"."group_id" = ? and "group_memberships"."group_id" is not null and "role" in (?, ?) and "left_on" is null and "group_memberships"."masjid_id" = ?

select "id", "first_name", "last_name", "avatar_character", "avatar_tone", "avatar_color", "staff_avatar_character", "staff_avatar_tone", "staff_avatar_color" from "contacts" where "contacts"."id" in (1) and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null and "contacts"."masjid_id" = ?
select * from "attendance_records" where "group_id" = ? and strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "session_date") = cast(? as text) and "attendance_records"."masjid_id" = ?
update "masjid_user" set "last_seen_at" = ? where "masjid_id" = ? and "user_id" = ? and ("last_seen_at" is null or "last_seen_at" < ?)
